title: finding(board): this repo's decision box measures ZERO while 14 decision-titled cards sit in pm:queue — the maintainer inbox reads empty and none of the 14 carries the label that makes a card undispatchable
body:
## The measurement

Taken by the `domain:ui` execution seat #1 (`session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf`) during round-1 board reading, 2026-09-20T23:33Z, by REST enumeration over `objectstack-ai/objectui` (⛔ not semantic search, which 403s for this seat).

| reading | value |
|:--|--:|
| open issues carrying `needs-user-decision` in this repo | **0** |
| open `domain:ui` + `pm:queue` cards whose title is `[Decision]` / `[decision]` / `DECISION NEEDED` / `decision(...)` | **14** |
| open `domain:ui` + `pm:queue` cards carrying no `priority:*` at all | **5** |

⭐ **Lit control**: the same enumeration on `labels=pm:queue&state=open` returns **259**. ⇒ the zero on the first row is a reading, ⛔ not a dead instrument.

⚠️ **Reachable radius**: open, non-PR issues in this repo, matched on `labels` and on the `title`. ⛔ **Outside the radius (so a zero there is not a reading)**: card bodies and comments, closed cards, PRs, and the sister repo.

## Why this matters, in the two places it bites

**① The maintainer's inbox reads EMPTY when it is not.** `needs-user-decision` is 「决定待做……维护者的收件箱」. A count of 0 says there is nothing waiting. Fourteen cards whose own titles say a decision is what they are waiting for say otherwise.

**② A decision card sitting in `pm:queue` is DISPATCHABLE-SHAPED.** The state model is explicit that a `needs-user-decision` card is 「永不派发」 — but that guard keys on the **label**, and none of these carries it. ⇒ nothing mechanical stops an execution seat from claiming one and handing it to a dev, and the dev then meets an unmade product decision with no fork named. This seat avoided it only by reading the titles.

## The 14

objectui#10097 · objectui#9910 · objectui#9306 · objectui#9002 · objectui#8932 · objectui#8824 · objectui#8817 · objectui#8509 · objectui#7750 · objectui#7659 · objectui#7609 · objectui#6952 · objectui#6941 · objectui#5157

⚠️ **⛔ This card does NOT assert that all 14 are mislabelled.** A title is a claim, not a state, and some may have had their fork answered in a comment with the body never rewritten — this repo has measured that shape repeatedly. ⇒ the deliverable is a **per-card read**, ⛔ not a bulk relabel. Each one lands in exactly one of: the fork is still open ⇒ it belongs in the box; the fork was answered ⇒ it belongs in the queue and its title is stale; it was never a decision ⇒ title only.

The 5 with no `priority:*` (objectui#10097, objectui#10085, objectui#6900, objectui#5861, objectui#3906) are the separate, ordinary 析取④ half-state and are listed only so the same pass can clear them.

## Why the execution seat filed this instead of fixing it

`priority:*`, `domain:*` and pm-state routing have a single producer, the triage seat, and an execution seat 「误标 ⛔ 不自行改」. ⛔ Hanging `pm:retriage` on 14 cards would also be the wrong shape: this is **one systemic observation**, not 14 independent mislabels.

## ⭐ The mechanisable half

The condition is machine-detectable with no new vocabulary: *a card whose title matches the decision shape while carrying `pm:queue` and not `needs-user-decision`*. That is the same family the half-state patrol already reports. ⚠️ And this repo's patrol **cannot currently run**: `half-state-patrol.yml` resolves its anchor from repository variable `HALF_STATE_ANCHOR_ISSUE`, which is unset — a supported configuration that delivers to the run summary only, and repository variables sit outside every agent seat's API surface. ⇒ recorded UNAVAILABLE — NOT MEASURED, ⛔ never as passed.

## Dedupe words

`needs-user-decision zero decision box empty` · `[Decision] title in pm:queue not in the inbox` · `decision card dispatchable no needs-user-decision label` · `half-state patrol anchor unset objectui` · `pm:queue no priority half-state`
